children: may retrace into a range of $82.39-$83.08 per barrel, as the bounce looks exhausted around a resistance at $84.31.
Strengthening the resistance is a similar one established by the falling channel in the middle. The exhaustion suggests a completion of a small wave c.
A break above $84.91 may lead to a gain to $88, as indicated by the channel technique. On the daily chart, the market faces a resistance zone of $83.41-$84.35. It may retrace moderately.

A break above $84.35 may open the way towards $88.57, near $88 (hourly chart). The downtrend would be considered to have resumed, once the market closes below $81.68 on Thursday, the previous trading session's open price.
